name: St. Charles County (Unincorporated)
notes: UDO Ch. 405. P&Z third Wednesday 7 PM; County Council 2nd & last Monday 7 PM (work session 6 PM); both at County Executive Building, 100 N Third St, 3rd floor. 2026 P&Z schedule not posted (page links 2025); deadlines projected as Friday 26 days before.

name: City of St. Charles
notes: P&Z usually 2nd Monday 6 PM; deadline is the prior meeting date, 5 PM, by email to PZ@stcharlescitymo.gov. City Council 1st & 3rd Tuesday 7 PM (work session 2nd Tuesday 6 PM). City Hall 200 N Second St, 4th floor. Community Development (636) 949-3222. P&Z page lists current members.

name: City of St. Peters
notes: P&Z first Wednesday 6:30 PM; Board of Aldermen 2nd & 4th Thursday 6:30 PM (work session 5 PM); both at Justice Center, 1020 Grand Teton Dr. Rezoning/PUD/SUP need Land Use Review Committee pre-submittal. Planning (636) 477-6600 x1670. Site blocks scripted requests; use a browser.

name: City of O'Fallon
notes: P&Z: 11 citizens + Mayor + Council rep. Meets 7 PM at Municipal Centre. Submittals due noon on deadline, emailed to recording secretary. Annual schedule posted on P&Z page.

name: City of Wentzville
notes: Planning Division (636) 639-2032. City Hall 1001 Schroeder Creek Blvd.

name: City of Lake Saint Louis
notes: Has an online ZoningHub map, good candidate for automated parcel lookup. P&Z first Thursday 6 PM, deadline 35 days before; items go to Board of Aldermen the third Monday. Aldermen 1st & 3rd Monday 6 PM. City Hall 200 Civic Center Dr. Community Development 636-625-7936. P&Z page lists members.

name: City of Dardenne Prairie
notes: P&Z 2nd Wednesday 7 PM (work session 6 PM); Board of Aldermen 1st & 3rd Wednesday 7 PM. City Hall Board Room, 2032 Hanley Rd. No submittal deadline schedule published; ask City Administrator Kyle Michel, 636-755-5303. Site moved to dardenneprairie.gov. P&Z page lists members.

name: City of Cottleville
notes: P&Z usually 1st Monday 7 PM, City Hall 5490 Fifth St. Rezoning application fee $800. BOA usually 3rd Wednesday 7 PM (from notices; confirm).

name: City of Weldon Spring
notes: P&Z 1st Monday 7:30 PM; Board of Aldermen 2nd & 4th Thursday 7:30 PM. City Hall 5401 Independence Rd. City Clerk (636) 441-2110. Website moved to weldonspring.gov (Munibit; calendar and agendas load via JavaScript, use a browser). Only the current agenda is kept online; no submittal deadlines published.

name: Village of Josephville
notes: Village board; may have no P&Z commission.
